peoples_entry.name: Yusar (Carcosa & Henge)
peoples_entry.note: Cybernetics tribe inhabiting the ruined arcologies of Carcosa and Henge along the Eternal State frontier, speaking an avoidance dialect of swapped compounds ('Spēk-Stak') and maintaining vacuum-tube, ceramic-insulator, induction-coil, biogel-splice, drone-sensor, and server-stack tech (LORE.md §6.19).
